title: At width N every live job is issued the whole run budget
description:
dispatch.go:1042-1045 puts r.budget.Effective on each dispatch and dispatch.go:1120 puts it on the job spec as Limits.MaxCostUSD. With the dispatch window (tick 5fx) N jobs are live at once, and each carries the run's entire budget: the run can authorise N x effective while ReportBudget told the operator one number.

Harmless on today's substrate - dispatch.go:1110-1119 records that the number is informational because the credential is flat-rate and unmetered - but Appendix A #12 promises that the number REPORTED is the number that will govern, and on a metered executor that promise would be false by a factor of the width. The width is the missing divisor.

Found by the concurrency audit of 5fx.
acceptance_criteria: The budget a dispatch carries accounts for the run's width, so the sum authorised across every live job cannot exceed the reported effective budget. A test covers a run at width > 1. What the operator is told at submission is what governs.
